title: Rosalind and the Verdict
author: Lena Okonkwo
blurb: Coral Joubert, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
